title: Original site of Delhi‑Topra Ashokan Pillar
subject: Geography
caption: Location of the original Delhi‑Topra Ashokan pillar in the Pong valley, northern India.
altText: A textbook-quality map on a white background showing India with state boundaries; the northern region is highlighted, and an inset zoom focuses on the Pong valley area in Punjab/Haryana. A red pinpoint marks the original site of the Delhi‑Topra Ashokan pillar. The map includes labels for India, Punjab, Haryana, the Satluj River, and the Pong valley, as well as a scale bar, north arrow, and legend.
